name: vidalune
description: Vidalune — Your media. Your server. A lightweight, Docker-first self-hosted media server.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace backend & npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace cloud
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace cloud
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace cloud
